visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Height Uses the Shorter Branch
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The tree has 4 levels (50, 30, 20, 10), but the program prints a height of 3.

solution.explanation: The height of a tree is the length of its longest path, so the taller subtree decides. Math.min follows the shorter branch and under-reports the height whenever the tree is unbalanced.
